title: VendPoint Industrial Vending Program — Machine Model Specification Sheet
content:
The VendPoint Industrial Vending Program places badge-operated machines in six models, ranked from the smallest to the largest. Each model is defined by the number of item selections it holds and by its dispensing technology.

**Selection capacity** is the number of item selections (doors, coils, carousel bays or crib positions) the machine holds. **Machine type** is the dispensing technology of the machine.

| | VendPoint Locker 12 | VendPoint Locker 24 | VendPoint Coil 40 | VendPoint Coil 60 | VendPoint Carousel 90 | VendPoint Smart Crib 300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Selection capacity | 12 | 24 | 40 | 60 | 90 | 300 |
| Machine type | locker | locker | coil | coil | carousel | smart crib |
| Entry gate: projected monthly usage, USD, at least | 400 | 750 | 1250 | 2000 | 3000 | 8000 |
| Entry gate: badge users, at least | 10 | 15 | 25 | 40 | 60 | 150 |

### Reading the sheet

- The rank runs from VendPoint Locker 12 (rank 1) to VendPoint Smart Crib 300 (rank 6); a "larger" model is one further along this order.
- A model's entry gate has two parts, projected monthly usage and badge users, and both are stated as minimums.
- The two locker models, the two coil models, the carousel model and the smart crib each share a machine type; the machine type, not the model name, is what rules written for "coil machines" or "a smart crib" refer to.

### Hypothetical illustration

A site projecting 1000.00 USD of monthly usage with 20 badge users meets the VendPoint Locker 24 gate (750 and 15) but not the VendPoint Coil 40 gate (1250 and 25), because the Coil 40 needs both figures and neither is reached. These figures are examples only.
